newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed ahead of USDA report.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed ahead of USDA report.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Tuesday, as local investors were largely sidelined ahead of the USDA's November crop production report, which will be released tonight, traders said.
Prices ranged from 60 yen lower to 190 yen higher, with benchmark November 1997 contract down 60 yen at 14,210. Daily volume was 33,217 lots.

Light technical selling from individual investors pressured down all months at the opening, traders said. Technical trading dominated the market, and most participants are waiting for the USDA report, they said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.68-1/2 per bushel at 0935 GMT, against $2.68-1/4 at Monday's close.
The spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.77 at 0935 GMT, against $6.80 at Monday's close.
